paragraphs.text: North Pontotoc’s Layla Gambrel pinned Tupelo’s Ivy Turnbo in 15 seconds at 165 pounds Thursday. Teammate McKinzie Pate won twice at 235 pounds, pinning an opponent from each of the other schools at the Nov. 19 wrestling meet in Tupelo.

Pate pinned Starkville’s London Zollicoffer in 2 minutes, 48 seconds and Tupelo’s Gabriella Holland in 46 seconds. At 185, North Pontotoc’s Tori Matthews went the distance against Starkville’s Caileigh Nichols and won a 10–4 decision.

At the lighter weights, Khloe Forman beat Starkville’s Taylor Moody by fall in 37 seconds at 132. Khloe Holcomb at 100 pounds, Harper Dunn at 114 and Daysia Walker at 126 also pinned their Starkville opponents.

Aden Harden had North Pontotoc’s quickest boys pin against Starkville, stopping Roman Mitchell in 25 seconds at 175 pounds. Carson Hale won by fall in 1:17 at 165. Haze Swords beat Starkville’s Jake Ruhl 14–7 at 106, and Jesus Lopez won a 9–2 decision against Jon Oliver at 132.
